reasoning: While content preservation is generally strong (shingling recall 0.913, composite score 0.8367), multiple structural and formatting defects strictly prohibit auto-approval. Specifically, the conversion improperly retained 56 header/footer elements and displaced 32 inline hyperlinks into standalone elements, both of which are explicit blockers for auto-approval. Furthermore, the loss of semantic text formatting (bolding), flattened lists, and reading order splices at page boundaries mandate human intervention.

In the rendered HTML, this bold formatting is lost, resulting in plain text. Because this formatting carries meaning by distinguishing the terms being defined or listed from their subsequent descriptions, its absence is a major defect.
